free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable: API access requires an active Meetup Pro subscription and is revoked when it expires.

rate_limits.correction: The GraphQL guide states 500 query points per 60 seconds; a current Help Center article separately says there is no strict automatic request cap and that usage is monitored.

example.correction: Use POST https://api.meetup.com/gql-ext with Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_TOKEN}, Content-Type: application/json, and a JSON GraphQL query body. The legacy GET /find/upcoming_events request is obsolete.

notes: Meetup replaced legacy REST access with a Pro-only GraphQL API in February 2025. The old docs URL currently redirects to the GraphQL guide. OAuth 2 is supported, with JWT also available. Official rate-limit pages conflict: the GraphQL guide states 500 points per 60 seconds, while the Help Center says no strict automatic cap. Official sources did not establish CORS or every claimed description capability.
